newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers little moved, demand thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers little moved, demand thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes hovered around Tuesday's levels with buyers still on the sidelines and sellers unwilling to lower offers, traders said.
"I cannot afford to lower offers to $96 per tonne (380-cst), I would be selling at a loss," said a major.
Traders said stocks in Singapore are high and shipowners are unhurried to cover requirements.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $101-$104 and 380-cst at $95/$99 by most majors and independents.
